game.name: Denis Rusin
game.tagline: Crafting immersive worlds, one pixel at a time.
game.sub: I build games that pull players in and don't let go — from rapid prototypes to full commercial releases.

voice.name: Denis Rusin
voice.tagline: Giving breath and soul to every character.
voice.sub: From fierce villains to gentle narrators, I deliver performances that linger long after the last line.
voice.ctaSub: Or explore my game dev work →

game.p1: I'm a game developer with 7 years of professional experience shipping titles across PC, console, and mobile. My expertise spans systems design, gameplay programming, and real-time rendering.
game.p2: I've worked on everything from solo indie experiments to 15-person studio productions. I love the moment a mechanic clicks — when play becomes feel.
game.p3: Currently open to new collaborations, freelance contracts, and full-time roles.

voice.p1: I'm a professional voice actor with a four-octave range and a background in theatre and audio production. I've voiced characters for video games, animated series, audiobooks, and commercial campaigns.
voice.p2: My home studio is fully treated and equipped for remote sessions. I deliver broadcast-quality audio quickly and take direction with precision.
voice.p3: Available for character work, narration, e-learning, and commercial VO.

game.title: Neon Abyss 2
game.desc: A roguelite platformer set in a neon-soaked underworld. 200k+ copies sold on Steam. Systems design, gameplay programming, and custom shader work.

game.title: Siege Protocol
game.desc: Real-time multiplayer strategy with destructible environments. Built entirely in Unreal Engine 5. Networked using dedicated servers with rollback netcode.

game.title: Chromaveil
game.desc: A narrative puzzle game exploring grief through color mechanics. 48-hour jam winner, later expanded to a full release. Solo dev.

game.title: Voidstep Engine
game.desc: A custom 2D game engine written in C++ with an ECS architecture, an integrated level editor, and a Lua scripting layer.

voice.title: Ironclad Chronicles
voice.desc: Lead antagonist "Lord Valen" in this 80-hour fantasy RPG. Over 12,000 lines of dialogue across 3 DLC expansions. Worked under AAA studio direction.

voice.title: Galaxy Drift — Audiobook
voice.desc: Narrator and 14 distinct characters across a 9-part sci-fi audiobook series. Produced entirely in my home studio. 4.9★ listener rating.

voice.title: Midnight Tactics
voice.desc: Squad commander "Captain Rhys" in this tactical shooter. Directed remotely, 6,000 lines. Also provided additional enemy soldier voices.

voice.title: TechNova Brand Campaign
voice.desc: National commercial campaign for a fintech startup. Delivered 40+ broadcast spots in English and Spanish. Warm, authoritative brand voice.

contact.heading: Let's Work Together

contact.voice: Need a voice for your game, film, or commercial? Let's make something unforgettable.
